source.manualTitle: Whirlpool/KitchenAid ACU French Door Refrigerator (W11509412A, ~27 cu ft)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating. For live voltage checks, verify controls are off, use proper PPE, and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Diagnostics
steps.body: Service Diagnostics entered at step 01. Press SW5/SW4 to navigate to the test number for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press SW5 to move to the next step in the sequence. Press SW4 to back up.

steps.title: Navigate to Service Test 59
steps.body: In Service Diagnostics Mode, press SW5 to advance until the dispenser display shows 59. Press SW4 to go back. Amber Order Filter = step number; red Replace Filter = step result.

steps.title: Run motor sequence
steps.body: Press SW3 to step motor sequence. Digit 1: 0=off, 1=CW to home, 2=off, 3=CCW to home. Digit 2: 0=in progress, 1=completed, 2=timeout (70 s).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press SW3 to step motor sequence. Digit 1: 0=off, 1=CW to home, 2=off, 3=CCW to home. Digit 2: 0=in progress, 1=completed, 2=timeout (70 s).

steps.title: Motor finds home
steps.body: Did motor complete home position (digit 2 = 1) without timeout?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Did motor complete home position (digit 2 = 1) without timeout?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Motor lost position — E2. Check for ice obstruction or replace ice maker module.

steps.title: Replace ice maker module
steps.oemOutcome: Ice maker motor did not find home — obstruction or failed motor/driver.

steps.title: Ice maker motor verified
steps.oemOutcome: Motor sequence completed in service test 59.
